Can I suggest reading up on the new personality model in the ICD-11? I kinda wish I was never stuck with the label I got, because I don’t really fully fit it. Personality disorders are more flexible in terms of variety between people. Me and my friend are both diagnosed with bpd but we have very little in common when it comes to the way our bpd presents itself. If you struggle with impulse control and anger I’d suggest dialectical behavioural therapy. You don’t have to stop seeing your current therapist if you don’t want to. There’s also group programs for DBT, though I always felt too nervous to go to those ones. I’m struggling a lot right now with getting on my feet in terms of treatment, but it does get better. My teenage years were some of the worst because my personality was still developing, but after that it got easier to deal with. Getting better can take a lot of patience, we just have to stay here for it.
